selection_authority: Source metadata and source-only pixel ownership audit before any PB18 model call. The four positive, two no-portal, and two same-frame tenant-decoy roles were frozen before OCR, ADE20K semantics, or portal proposals. Exact filenames and aliases were absent from PB1-PB17 active source files and named-poi manifests.

human_truth_freeze.coordinate_space: Downloaded 1280px Commons source images; XYXY pixels, right and bottom exclusive.
human_truth_freeze.membership_rule: A proposal is a member when its center is inside the frozen portal box and at least 50% of the proposal area overlaps that box.
human_truth_freeze.ownership_rule: Rows 7-8 contain both the target-building portal and a separately signed tenant portal. Target and decoy boxes are instance labels; those frames are not frame-level negatives.
